theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · exact ⟨h⟩
  intro s1 s2 r μ
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL htr2, ⟨hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2⟩⟩
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, ⟨HomBisimilarity.refl⟩⟩
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
      exact ⟨s2', htr2, ⟨hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2⟩⟩
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL htr1, ⟨hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1⟩⟩
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, ⟨HomBisimilarity.refl⟩⟩
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
      exact ⟨s1', htr1, ⟨hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1⟩⟩
